a.description: The Householder reflectors with shape ``[..., m, n]``, as returned by the internal ``geqrf``/``geqp3`` primitives. Alternatively, one can use :func:`jax.numpy.linalg.qr` with ``mode="raw"``, but in this case the returned ``a`` must be transposed with ``.mT`` (see example below).

taus.description: The Householder scalar factors with shape ``[..., k]``, as returned by ``geqrf``/``geqp3`` or the second element of the tuple from :func:`jax.numpy.linalg.qr` with ``mode="raw"``.

c.description: The matrix to multiply by Q, with shape ``[..., c_rows, c_cols]``.

left.description: If ``True``, compute ``Q @ C``. If ``False``, compute ``C @ Q``.

output.description: The result of multiplying ``c`` by Q (or ``Q^T``/``Q^H``), with the same shape as ``c``.
